name: Guinea Fowl Korma with Almond and Cardamom
description: French guinea fowl (pintade) slow-braised in a Pakistani korma sauce built on toasted almond paste, green and black cardamom, deeply caramelised onions, and incrementally tempered yoghurt. A halal curated fusion recipe.
keywords: guinea fowl korma, pintade korma, almond cardamom korma, halal guinea fowl recipe, slow braise korma, Pakistani French fusion
recipeIngredient: 1 guinea fowl (pintade), about 1.4 kg (3 lb), jointed into 8 pieces, skin on
1 tsp fine sea salt (for the bird)
70 g (½ cup) blanched almonds, lightly toasted
1 small piece mace (about ¼ tsp ground)
2 medium onions (about 320 g / 11 oz), thinly sliced
240 g (1 cup) full-fat plain yoghurt, at room temperature, whisked smooth
Pinch of saffron steeped in 2 tbsp warm milk (optional)

recipeInstructions.name: Salt and turmeric the bird
recipeInstructions.text: Pat the guinea fowl pieces dry. Rub with 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp turmeric. Set aside at room temperature for 20 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Make the almond paste
recipeInstructions.text: Blend toasted almonds, milk, and ground green cardamom to a smooth, thick paste. Set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Brown the guinea fowl
recipeInstructions.text: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a 5-litre Dutch oven over medium-high. Brown the guinea fowl in two batches, skin side down first, 4 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Bloom the whole spices
recipeInstructions.text: Reduce heat to medium. Add remaining 2 tbsp ghee. Add green cardamom, cloves, black cardamom, bay leaves, and mace. Stir for 60 to 90 seconds until aromatic.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the onions to deep mahogany
recipeInstructions.text: Add sliced onions and a pinch of salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring every 4 to 5 minutes, for 30 to 35 minutes until deep mahogany in colour.

recipeInstructions.name: Add ginger and garlic
recipeInstructions.text: Add ginger and garlic pastes to the centre of the pot. Cook, stirring into the onions, for 3 to 4 minutes until the raw smell is gone.

recipeInstructions.name: Add ground spices
recipeInstructions.text: Add ground coriander, cumin, and white pepper. Stir for 1 minute.

recipeInstructions.name: Add almond paste
recipeInstructions.text: Stir in the almond-cardamom paste. Cook for 2 minutes, folding into the onion masala.

recipeInstructions.name: Temper in the yoghurt (bhunai)
recipeInstructions.text: Reduce heat to low. Add whisked yoghurt 2 tablespoons at a time, stirring until each addition is absorbed before adding the next. Continue until all yoghurt is incorporated and the fat has separated back out, about 10 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Braise the guinea fowl
recipeInstructions.text: Return the browned guinea fowl pieces to the pot. Add 200 ml water. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, reduce heat to low, and braise for 45 to 55 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Check and finish
recipeInstructions.text: Taste and adjust salt. Stir in kewra water and saffron milk if using. Add single cream if desired. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes if sauce needs thickening.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest and serve
recipeInstructions.text: Turn off heat. Rest with lid on for 10 minutes. Scatter toasted flaked almonds and rose petals over the top before serving.
